policy: Only explicitly authorized, verified public works. Keep one card per stable id; update an existing record for a same-work revision. Do not infer publication, scores or adoption.

items.name: Bilingual Router LoRA
items.alt: Bilingual Router: strict all-field accuracy 7.6% to 47.2%, JSON validity 98.6% to 95.5%; 576 synthetic tests, one run. Read results and failures.
items.details: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, base → adapter, 576 frozen synthetic tests. One seed and run, with the schema supplied to both models. Strict all-field accuracy improved while strict JSON validity fell; unseen-operation failures remain visible. These are experimental results, not production performance. [Model & reproduction](https://huggingface.co/WideChaos/bilingual-router-qwen2.5-0.5b-lora-v2/blob/main/README.md).
items.summary: Test a small model that turns bilingual requests into structured actions.

items.name: Evidence Agent
items.alt: Evidence Agent: historical local 14B evaluation 9 of 20; live 4B demo has no equivalent verified score. Traces do not guarantee correctness. Read evaluation and failures.
items.details: the 9/20 result belongs to the documented local Qwen3-14B run on October 3, 2026. The live 4B demo has no equivalent verified score. Tool traces support inspection, not a correctness guarantee. Free GPU quota can interrupt inference; labeled tool walkthroughs remain separate. [Demo & setup](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/evidence-agent).
items.summary: Inspect an agent’s answer through its tool calls and source traces.

items.name: JSON Wire Browser Lab
items.alt: JSON Wire Browser Lab: inspect browser decoding, JSON parsing and re-encoding separately. Parsed values can round-trip while original bytes change; no semantic correctness guarantee.
items.headline: What survives a round-trip?
question: Inspect browser JSON decoding,
parsing and re-encoding separately.
items.result_label: A parsed value can survive a round-trip
items.details: A browser-local workbench separates UTF-8 decoding, JSON parsing and re-encoding, with fixed byte fixtures and a frozen Python reference. A large integer can change even when the parsed value round-trips. These checks do not prove semantic correctness or sanitize untrusted input. Exported reports include input bytes and runtime details; review them before sharing. [Public lab & source](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/json-wire-boundary-lab).
items.summary: Inspect how decoding and JSON round-trips change values and bytes.

items.name: Offline Evidence Finder
items.alt: Offline Evidence Finder: browser-local English and Chinese lexical retrieval with exact quotes and UTF-16 offsets. One of four unanswerable development queries returned a hit; matching quotes do not prove semantic support.
items.headline: Exact quotes are not proof.
question: Search English and Chinese text,
then export quotes and source offsets.
items.details: Browser-local English and Chinese lexical retrieval exports exact quotes, UTF-16 offsets and source text. After a disclosed sample-extraction correction, one of four unanswerable queries still matched an unrelated excerpt. These hand-picked development queries are not a blind retrieval benchmark; a location match does not establish truth, answerability or semantic support. No model inference or training. [Public lab & source](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/offline-evidence-finder) · [English write-up](https://widechaos.cn/blog/offline-evidence-finder-en) · [中文说明](https://widechaos.cn/blog/offline-evidence-finder-zh).
items.summary: Find exact quotes in English or Chinese text, with source offsets.

items.name: Tiny Hash Intent
items.alt: Tiny Hash Intent: one from-scratch fit, four evaluation representations and 301 retained errors across 3,080 test rows. English closed-set classification has no OOD rejection; int8 storage is not a speed benchmark.
items.headline: Small model, real errors.
question: Run a trained intent classifier
locally, with its full error report.
items.result_label: Test errors · One fit, four views
limits: English closed set · No OOD rejection
Int8 storage is not a speed benchmark
items.details: One from-scratch fit on BANKING77 is evaluated as float/int8 storage with raw/calibrated probabilities: four representations, not four trained models. All 301 errors on the official 3,080-row test set are retained; the two quantization-changed predictions are wrong before and after. This is a previously seen benchmark, not a historical blind test. The English 77-class closed set always selects a known class, with no out-of-domain rejection. The browser dequantizes int8 storage for floating-point inference; no integer-kernel or speed-up claim. [Public model demo & source](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/tiny-hash-intent) · [English write-up](https://widechaos.cn/blog/tiny-hash-intent-en) · [中文说明](https://widechaos.cn/blog/tiny-hash-intent-zh).
items.summary: Try a small English intent classifier and inspect its retained errors.

items.name: Split Boundary Audit · Group Planner
items.alt: Split Boundary Audit Group Planner: keep declared groups and exact-text connections together across train, validation and test. All records retained; greedy planning is not optimal and does not certify statistical independence.
items.headline: Keep groups together.
question: Plan train, validation and test splits,
then export records and review warnings.
items.details: A local browser planner keeps caller-declared groups and groups connected by exact text together across train, validation and test, then exports the full plan and assigned records for the included Python auditor. It preserves every record, conflicting labels and achieved-ratio deviations. The 36-record synthetic example has 12 declared groups and 10 connected units; an 80/10/10 target yields 30/3/3 records, with one normalization candidate and one conflicting-label set retained for review. Normalized matches are candidates only. A retained counterexample shows the single-pass greedy planner is not globally optimal. Group provenance is supplied by the caller; a CLEAR audit does not prove statistical independence or absence of semantic leakage. Original Apache-2.0 code and synthetic examples; no model or external dataset. [Public planner, source & audit](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/split-boundary-audit) · [English write-up](https://widechaos.cn/blog/split-boundary-audit-en) · [中文说明](https://widechaos.cn/blog/split-boundary-audit-zh).
items.summary: Plan train, validation and test splits while keeping declared groups together.

shelf_card.title: Plan dataset splits

items.name: Annotation Pair Review
items.alt: Annotation Pair Review: 100% conditional agreement can cover just one of twelve synthetic records. Browser-local manual review keeps disagreements, abstentions and unfinished work visible. Agreement is not accuracy; no autosave.
items.headline: Agreement needs coverage.
question: Compare two annotation files,
then review each record manually.
limits: No autosave · Export to keep work
items.details: A browser-local workbench shows conditional label agreement beside coverage, keeping disagreements, abstentions and unfinished records visible for manual final decisions. The partial synthetic example reaches 100% agreement with only 1 of 12 records labelled by both roles; the default example has 4/12 coverage and 2/4 identical labels (50%). These are scripted role annotations, not independent human annotators, accuracy or gold labels. Full inventory, taxonomy and record order must match; no intersection-only merging or automatic adjudication. The tab does not autosave: refresh loses unsaved work. Downloaded snapshots can restore a review and contain full original texts and notes; review them before sharing. Checksums establish consistency, not authenticity. No model, training or measured adoption. [Public workbench, source & reproduction](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/annotation-pair-review) · [English write-up](https://widechaos.cn/blog/annotation-pair-review-en) · [中文说明](https://widechaos.cn/blog/annotation-pair-review-zh).
items.summary: Compare two annotation files and manually resolve disagreements.

items.name: Local Label Queue
items.alt: Local Label Queue: twelve abstentions can produce 100% reviewed progress with zero assigned labels. Browser-local manual text labeling preserves labels, abstentions and unfinished work. No autosave or label-quality judgment.
items.headline: Reviewed with no labels.
question: Label text or record an abstention,
then export every source record.
limits: Review progress is not label quality
items.details: A browser-local manual text-labeling queue keeps labelled, abstained and unfinished records separate and preserves every source text, id, group and annotation in exports. In the synthetic all-abstained example, all 12 records are reviewed but zero labels are assigned. The running demo instead has 2 labelled, 1 abstained and 9 unfinished records; revision 5 counts edits, not reviewed records. These authored examples have no gold labels or independently verified human annotators. No model, training, automatic quality check or measured adoption. There is no autosave: refresh loses unsaved work. Download a checkpoint first; restoration requires a verified preview and explicit full-session replacement, with no merge. Exports contain full source texts and annotations, so review before sharing. Hashes establish consistency, not signatures, encryption or authenticity. [Public queue, source & reproduction](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/local-label-queue) · [English write-up](https://widechaos.cn/blog/local-label-queue-en) · [中文说明](https://widechaos.cn/blog/local-label-queue-zh).
items.summary: Label text while keeping abstentions and unfinished records separate.

items.name: Prediction Metric Desk
items.alt: Prediction Metric Desk: a synthetic 75% conditional accuracy score is three of four evaluated records, while known-label coverage is four of seven. Retain missing, abstained, invalid and duplicate outputs. Saved predictions only; no new model training.
items.headline: Which records got counted?
question: Audit saved classification outputs,
keeping gaps and invalid rows visible.
limits: Completion bounds are not confidence limits
items.details: A browser-local classification-result audit keeps the full inventory beside missing predictions, abstentions, duplicate IDs and invalid rows. In the eight-record synthetic fault example, conditional accuracy is 3/4 (75%), known-label coverage is 4/7 and total decision coverage is 5/8: different denominators, not interchangeable scores. Hypothetical completion bounds are not forecasts or confidence intervals. Saved BANKING77 predictions are recalculated, not a new model, inference, calibration run or blind benchmark; seven normalized train/test overlaps remain. No automatic repair, renormalization, clipping or invented gold labels. Full source texts and predictions appear in exports; review before sharing. Memory-only, no autosave or checkpoint restoration; refresh clears work. Hash consistency does not prove authenticity or gold-label quality. Code and synthetic fixtures are Apache-2.0; BANKING77 original and derived data retain CC BY 4.0 attribution. The standalone App passed the owner release gate; Hub embedding remained unverified in the original Edge context, with no established cause. [Standalone audit desk](https://widechaos-prediction-metric-desk.static.hf.space/index.html) · [HF source, methods & licenses](https://huggingface.co/spaces/WideChaos/prediction-metric-desk).
items.summary: Audit saved predictions, missing outputs and the denominators behind scores.
